items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: The pedal steel guitar isn’t taught at Juilliard because it isn’t Mozart.

ctx.x: Yeah. And it was a process. When I was in school there was no jazz, organized jazz faculty. It was a bit of a student effort. But it’s interesting because sometimes when young people take it upon themselves to not only study but to perform it, it means more. You’re highly invested in it.

Well I think if enough people are willing to take courses in ditch digging that the college or the university would create a department because it would attract people. It’s, I mean any field of knowledge is subjective as to who wants to know and who wants to teach it and what class of society it belongs to. I mean a lot of this goes back to our basic assumptions about race and class and other things too. The pedal steel guitar isn’t taught at Juilliard because it isn’t Mozart.
